What I do

I specialize in bridging the gap between complex backend systems and intuitive frontend interfaces. Whether it's training pipelines or user dashboards, I write code that works, scales, and stays out of the user's way.

Full-Stack Engineering

Building resilient web applications from database architecture to responsive interfaces. Focusing on type safety, scalable patterns, and flawless user experiences.

AI-Integrated Products

Embedding large language models into existing workflows. Generating context-aware assessments, automated grading, and personalized coaching interfaces.

Infrastructure & Systems

Deploying and managing high-performance environments. Orchestrating multi-GPU workloads, configuring secure gateways, and ensuring uptime for demanding research applications.
